{{distinguish|Morgan Prize}}
[[File:De_Morgan_Augustus.jpg | thumb | right | alt=Picture of Augustus De Morgan | Augustus De Morgan]]
The '''De Morgan Medal''' is a prize for outstanding contribution to [[mathematics]], awarded by the [[London Mathematical Society]]. The Society's most prestigious award, it is given in memory of [[Augustus De Morgan]], who was the first President of the society. It is awarded every three years, usually to a mathematician living and working in the [[United Kingdom]].<ref name=st-andrews/>

In 1968, [[Mary Cartwright]] became the first woman to receive the award.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://mathwomen.agnesscott.org/women/prizes.htm#demorgan|title=Prizes, Awards, and Honors for Women Mathematicians: De Morgan Medal of the London Mathematical Society|work=Biographies of Women Mathematicians|publisher=Agnes Scott College|access-date=2024-01-29}}</ref>
